facts.fact: The single pinned file publishes complete I0/I1 helpers and a higher-integer-order I helper. The higher-order program publishes start2*(n+floor(sqrt(40*n))) and rescale magnitude1e10 with factor1e-10 together. They are not combined from different sources.

The program uses backward modified-Bessel-I recurrence and normalizes by its own I0 helper. Its final mathematical grouping is(target recurrence value times I0) divided by the final zero-order recurrence value. This differs from grouping the I0 division first.

Both seeds use the fixed3.75 magnitude split. The low polynomial argument is the product of two quotients x/3.75. The I0 high expression groups exponential divided by square root before multiplying its fixed polynomial. All coefficients and arithmetic grouping belong to this complete published candidate.

This version does not coerce its input tensor to a fixed dtype. It initializes recurrence states with exact0 and1 tensors and uses the caller's tensor in recurrence arithmetic. The source therefore differs from MONAI's explicitly torch.float input conversion. Any claimed binary64 realization still needs its elementary-operation and store semantics stated and tested.

The pinned higher-order helper has exact zero-input handling and negative-input integer-order parity. It does not publish Excel's measured overflow-admission policy. That policy remains a separate application obligation.
